title: Geodesic string counting invariants and arithmetic of multiplicities
summary: We study rational valued counts of geodesic strings (reparametrization equivalence classes of closed geodesics) for complete Riemann-Finsler manifolds, based on the Fuller index of the geodesic flow. The main conceptual result is a product type formula for these counts. Combined with aspects of KAM theory, it yields the following sample phenomenon. Let $g$ be a generic Finsler metric on $T ^{2}$, sufficiently $C ^{\infty }$-close to a flat metric, and fix a prime $p$ and a nontrivial free homotopy class $β$.
